name: Don't Romance Me
source:
You meet a young man in a bar and he invites you to join him in the nearest alley.  You never leave that alley.

[Edited from [url=https://masterwren.itch.io/dont-romance-me]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在酒吧遇見一名年輕男人，他邀請你去最近的小巷。你再也沒有離開那條巷子。

[編輯自[url=https://masterwren.itch.io/dont-romance-me]Itch.io[/url]]
